note: Hand-made test, 2026-11-20. Each scene starts at the first word of its verse (the first at the chapter's first word). Pictures: OpenAI gpt-image-2.5-sunburst, medium, 1920x1088, about 1 cent each; 03 was made from 01 so the writer keeps his face. Rules: only what the verses say, no figure for God, nothing glowing, no text in the picture.

scenes.shows: An old man looks at his own open hands, remembering what they touched.
Men and women on a lake shore watch the sunrise.
The same old man writes the letter, two companions beside him, all glad.
Clear sunlight over hills and a lake; nothing dark, no one in it.
A man walks alone into a dark alley, leaving a lit doorway behind.
A group of men and women walk together in bright morning light.
A man kneels at a stream and washes his face in clean water.
A closed scroll lies untouched on a table; the daylight does not reach it.
